visualCharacteristics.purpose: grid or list of article teaser cards with category tag, title, optional excerpt, read-more link and photo

contentPattern.structure: One row per article. Cells: image (picture only, optional) | body (optional short category tag paragraph before the heading, heading, optional excerpt, read-more link). Cells may come in either order; empty or missing image cells are tolerated. With image-top, a teaser whose body has a single link becomes fully clickable

reuseGuidance: Use for editorial/advice article teasers. Options: image-top (photo above text), image (same, photo-led cards), list-rows (one article per row with photo left), featured (first article large, others stacked). For product or account tiles use cards-product or cards-plan. A filterable article grid pairs this block with content-filter.
